User-agent: *
Allow: /
# keep crawl budget on real pages; data endpoints stay open so Google can render live numbers
Disallow: /api/
# The public, keyless data API. llms.txt tells assistants to fetch these mid-answer, and until
# 2026-09-14 the blanket Disallow above hid every one of them from bingbot and Googlebot - which is
# 71% of the crawling we actually get, and what feeds Copilot and Google's AI answers. A longer
# matching rule wins in robots.txt, so these lines re-open exactly the endpoints we advertise.
Allow: /api/v1/
Allow: /api/competition
Allow: /api/apiplan
Allow: /api/openapi
Allow: /api/changelog
Allow: /api/latam/
Allow: /api/cg/
Allow: /api/price
Allow: /api/klines
Allow: /api/screener
Allow: /api/fng
Allow: /api/calendar
Allow: /api/symbols
Disallow: /telegram/
Disallow: /chat/
